content.tex: A INVESTIGATION (QUESTIONS 1 TO 4)
REVERSE DIFFERENCES (30 marks)
You are advised to spend no more than 50 minutes on this part.
This investigation looks at what happens when you reverse the digits of a number and then find the difference between the new number and the original number. This is called the reverse difference.
STEP 1 Write down a 2-digit number. STEP 2 Reverse the digits of the number. STEP 3 Find the positive difference between the two numbers.
Example 1 Example 2
STEP 1 Write a number 52 STEP \(1 13\) STEP 2 Reverse the digits 25 STEP \(2 31\) STEP 3 Find the difference \(52\begin{pmatrix}25 & = & 27 & STEP & 3 & 31\end{pmatrix}13 = 18\)
